title: Food and agricultural products at the U.S. border
facts: Travelers entering the United States must declare agricultural products as required by CBP and USDA rules.
Whether a food, plant, seed, meat or animal product may enter depends on the product and country of origin; some items are prohibited or restricted.
Declaring an agricultural item allows inspectors to determine admissibility and is different from attempting to conceal it.
Rules can change with animal and plant disease conditions, so current official guidance should be checked before travel.
